**Starts** once #62 is merged, and any other issue that adds a part of the UI (open question below).

## Why

Joe wants to redo the web app's look with Claude Design, Anthropic's design tool. Doing it once every part of the UI exists means the redo covers the whole UI at one time, instead of being redone each time a part is added. The option cards (#62) are the main part still missing. The redo changes how the app looks, not what it does or what the agents see.

## Design

- [Functional spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/functional-spec.md), sections 7.5 (option cards), 7.6, and 9 (the itinerary view).
- [Systems design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/systems.md), section 4 (the browser and the app).

## Open questions

- Which parts of the UI must be in before the redo starts? The option cards (#62) for sure. The weather and clothing text that #64 adds to the itinerary view is another candidate.
- How does the work go: Joe designs in Claude Design and Claude Code builds from the result, or something else? Raised by Joe on 2026-10-28.

## Do

To be written once the open questions are settled. Already known:

- Fix the day schedule's time column. It's 12.5rem wide with `white-space: nowrap`, so "Time set once a place is picked" runs into the stop text beside it, such as "Meal, local lunch after the hike". Seen in #62's local checks. Times that run past midnight overflow it too: "3:03 p.m. – 1:00 a.m. the next day" ran over "Free time, 9 h 57 m" on a Torrey day in #64's checks (moved from #220 on 2026-10-29). The fix follows from the text: the column has to fit it, or let it wrap. Check a day with a "the next day" time in the browser.

## Done when

To be written once the open questions are settled.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
